text.en:
The general supervision and control of PCTC is hereby transferred
to the Office of the National Security Adviser.

Repealing Clause. All executive orders, rules and regulations and
other issuances inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
City of Manila, October 22, 2002
By the President:
Che Al. Roariato
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Pola Ongoing r 16123 Executive Secretary
